landing_page.py.title: Dear ImGui Bundle
landing_page.py.text: Interactive Python & C++ apps for desktop, mobile, and web - powered by Dear ImGui.

welcome_imm_mode.py.title: What is an Immediate GUI
welcome_imm_mode.py.text: With Dear ImGui, your GUI code is simple and direct: no widget trees, no callbacks, no state synchronization. You call functions to create widgets, and they return the current value. That's it.

explorables/julia_map.py.title: The Mandelbrot set as a map of Julia sets
explorables/julia_map.py.text: Click a point of the Mandelbrot set to see its Julia set. Fly to famous values of c, and zoom into both pictures: near each point, the two sets look alike.

explorables/neural_spiral/neural_spiral..title: A tiny neural network learns two spirals
explorables/neural_spiral/neural_spiral..text: Can 16 neurons tell two spirals apart? Watch a tiny network learn, live. Then read how it works, formula by formula, next to its numpy code.

explorables/lesson_harmonic_motion.py.title: Simple harmonic motion
explorables/lesson_harmonic_motion.py.text: A mass on a spring, a pendulum at small angles, a vibrating string: they all follow the same mathematics. Adjust the mass and the spring stiffness, and watch how the motion changes.

explorables/double_pendulum.py.title: Double Pendulum
explorables/double_pendulum.py.text: A chaotic system where tiny changes in initial conditions lead to wildly different trajectories. Drag the angles to set initial positions, then release and watch chaos unfold.

explorables/fourier_epicycles.py.title: Fourier Epicycles
explorables/fourier_epicycles.py.text: Any closed curve can be approximated by a sum of rotating circles (Fourier series). Adjust the number of circles to see how the approximation improves.

explorables/boids.py.title: Boids
explorables/boids.py.text: Three trivial local rules (separation, alignment, cohesion), and a flock emerges. No leader, no plan. Turn the knobs to re-weight the rules and watch order appear or dissolve. Send in hunters that chase the swarm down, or flip on the cursor predator and scatter it yourself.

explorables/logistic_map.py.title: Logistic Map
explorables/logistic_map.py.text: A very simple equation (the logistic map: x(n+1) = r * x(n) * (1 - x(n))), used for example to model the growth of a population with limited resources, can lead to wildly different situations: either stable, periodic (in 2-cycles, 4-cycles, etc), or chaotic. Let's explore this.

imgui_demo.py.title: Dear ImGui: the full demo
imgui_demo.py.text: Every widget and feature of Dear ImGui, in Python. The reference to learn Dear ImGui by example (a port of imgui_demo.cpp).

implot_demo.py.title: ImPlot: the full demo
implot_demo.py.text: Every kind of plot of ImPlot, in Python: lines, scatter, bars, heatmaps, histograms, real-time plots and more (a port of implot_demo.cpp).

implot3d_demo.py.title: ImPlot3D: the full demo
implot3d_demo.py.text: Rotatable, zoomable 3D plots in Python: lines, scatter, surfaces, meshes and more (a port of implot3d_demo.cpp).

implot3d_butterfly.py.title: Lorenz Attractor & Butterfly Effect
implot3d_butterfly.py.text: ImPlot3D adds rotatable, zoomable 3D plots to Dear ImGui.

immvision.py.title: ImmVision: Download & Inspect Images
immvision.py.text: ImmVision is an image debugger for Dear ImGui with zoom, pan, pixel inspection, and colormaps.

fiatlight_image.py.title: Fiatlight: Image Pipeline
fiatlight_image.py.text: Fiatlight turns Python functions into interactive apps with visual pipelines. https://pthom.github.io/fiatlight

themes.py.title: Theming
themes.py.text: Dear ImGui Bundle supports theming at two levels: complete looks, and fine-tuning of colors, rounding and spacing.

layout_child.py.title: Resizable Layouts with begin_child
layout_child.py.text: ImGui's begin_child creates scrollable, nestable sub-regions. With ChildFlags_.resize_x or resize_y, the user can drag dividers to resize panels.

layout_docking.py.title: Docking Layouts with Hello ImGui
layout_docking.py.text: Hello ImGui provides a docking system: define named dock spaces, then assign windows to them. Windows can be dragged, tabbed, and rearranged by the user.

minimal_example.py.title: Deploy to the Web: Minimal HTML Example
minimal_example.py.text: Dear ImGui Bundle apps can run entirely in the browser using Pyodide. The HTML file below is a complete, self-contained app in about 80 lines - no server, no build step.

webgl_minimal_mandelbrot.py.title: Minimal WebGL fragment shader as the application background.
webgl_minimal_mandelbrot.py.text: Pyodide only. This demo calls the browser's WebGL2 API directly, through Python's js interop. On desktop, you would use PyOpenGL instead.

webgl_background_shader.py.title: Custom background using a shader, à la Shadertoy
webgl_background_shader.py.text: Runs on desktop AND in Pyodide, from the same source file. The shader is the famous "Seascape" by Alexander Alekseev (TDM, 2014). It's rendered as the application's background through hello_imgui's custom_background callback, with the ImGui parameter panel composited on top.

webgl_texture_in_image.py.title: Render a 3D cube with WebGL from Python, and display it in an ImGui window
webgl_texture_in_image.py.text: The cube is rendered into a texture, shown via imgui.image(): zero CPU/GPU round-trip on the steady-state path.

webaudio_minimal_beep.py.title: WebAudio: minimal beep, a Pyodide sanity check.
webaudio_minimal_beep.py.text: Pyodide only. Calls the browser's WebAudio API via Python's js interop. Click Beep to hear a short sine tone whose frequency and duration you can slide.
